name: pontua-rh-monorepo
description: Plataforma SaaS de Gestão de RH, DP e Ponto Eletrônico

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c "magenta.bold,cyan.bold" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c "magenta.bold,cyan.bold" "npm --workspace=@pontuarh/backend run start" "npm --workspace=@pontuarh/frontend run start"

author: Pontua RH Team
